_comment: Single source of truth for every pipeline parameter. Bucket names are NOT stored here: they come from the DHAI_BUCKET / DHAI_HOLDOUT_BUCKET environment variables or Colab Secrets.

dataset._comment_hf_revision: Pin an exact commit hash, never 'main'. Get one with: python -m src.step1_scrape_raw --resolve-revision
dataset._comment_version: v1.1 (Milestone 2) = v1.0 + quarantine, processed data contract, PII masking, model-ready inputs. Same raw revision and split salts as v1.0, so splits are unchanged (MINOR bump).

storage._comment: Bucket names come from DHAI_BUCKET / DHAI_HOLDOUT_BUCKET. local_root/local_holdout_root are used when DHAI_BUCKET is not set. download_dir, interim_dir, manifest_dir and audit_dir are always local (interim files still contain test rows before splitting, so they never go to a bucket). eda_dir holds the EDA figures and aggregate tables (no dataset text), committed to Git.

split._comment: b1 = sha256(group_id+future_salt) % 100 -> F1 [0,10), F2 [10,20); b2 = sha256(group_id+tdt_salt) % 10 -> train [0,8), dev 8, test 9. Groups larger than max_group_size are re-keyed on full context.

refusal_patterns: \bI (?:don['’]?t|do not) (?:feel comfortable|think I should|want to help)\b
features._comment: long_outlier_percentile is fitted on TRAIN only; refusal_patterns are case-insensitive regexes used for audit slicing only. v1.1: apostrophe-agnostic (the data mixes ' and ’) and rebuilt from the most common harmless-base reply openings in TRAIN (EDA E5).

shards._comment: Step 8. num_shards <= 1 disables sharding (default: one Parquet file is enough at ~24k training pairs). Set e.g. 4 for multi-worker loading in M3; shard sizes are multiples of batch_size.

pii_mask._comment: v1.1: step 3 replaces e-mail / phone matches (regexes in 'pii', e-mail first) by these tokens in the context and both replies. Identity keys (pair_id, group keys) are computed before masking.

poison_screen._comment: flag word n-grams occurring one-sidedly (chosen vs rejected) in >= min_pairs pairs

eval_slices._comment: fixed BEFORE the test set is read; len_diff in words; num_turns bins: 1 | 2-3 | 4+

model_inputs._comment: Step 11. Contexts longer than this are left-truncated by whole turns (newest kept). 256 words is roughly 330-350 subword tokens, leaving room for the reply in a 512-token encoder (planned M3 baseline); EDA E3 reports how many contexts this affects.

eda._comment: EDA settings: word-level similarity above which two replies count as near-identical; bins (words) for the length-gap analysis; group bootstrap resamples and seed (Lecture 4: resample the sampling unit, here the prompt group).
